name: button
title: Button
description: Solid button component with UI styling hooks and variant metadata.

meta.customization: Customize visual treatment through the ui-button classes and data-variant/data-size attributes.

parity.baseUi: Thin UI base button follows Base UI Button direction for native button semantics, disabled state, type passthrough, and styling hooks without adding app behavior. Gaps: loading/pending state, pressed/toggle semantics, polymorphic render helper, focus-visible data, and icon-only accessibility guardrails remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to Kobalte Button as a Solid-native button wrapper with pass-through props and disabled handling. Gaps: no shared Keystone polymorphic primitive, no link-button composition helper, and no data-disabled normalization beyond the UI wrapper yet.
